1.explanation:
• DataTable/DataTable.mdx & DataTable/docs/overview.mdx: Show how TableBatchActions is currently implemented and how totalSelected is rendered. Understanding this is vital to extending the component API.
• DataTable/migrate-to-7.x.md: Documents any API changes in v7 that may affect adding optional buttons into BatchActions.
• Button/Button.mdx & Button/docs/overview.mdx: Define the styling, props, and usage patterns for inline buttons—ensuring the new ‘Select all’ link/button matches Carbon’s design language.
• Checkbox/Checkbox.mdx: Describes header and row selection mechanics. Since the feature interacts with selection state (selecting across all pages), understanding the checkbox behavior is necessary to coordinate with the new button logic.
1.bug_scenario: Both screenshots illustrate a TablesBatchActions bar containing the current page’s selected count alongside a new “Select all” control. In the first image, a blue action bar atop a DataTable shows “50 items selected” then a vertical divider and a clickable “Select all (1 228)” area (cursor pointer on hover). Underneath is the standard table header with a checkbox in the column header and row checkboxes. In the second (Gmail) example, the mail toolbar icons appear on the left, and on the right the text “Select all 24 521 conversations in Primary” is rendered as a link. The feature request is to optionally insert this “Select all” button next to the totalSelected text in the TableBatchActions component so that it selects all items across all pages when clicked, not just the current page.
